MoonRock is a NFT project of 1815 unique crypto moon rocks on the Cardano blockchain.

These moon rocks are not just dumb rocks, they are not just NFTs. They are revenue generating NFTs. Each MoonRock is unique in its own way — no two look the same.

Some of these combinations can help you generate more revenue than the others ( more details coming soon), which makes some of these rocks very rare. All the rocks will be distributed with no bias and will be selected randomly for the users on the launch day ( ofcourse, on first come first serve basis).
